text: Straddling both NUMA nodes costs about 2% for a 32-core lease, and numactl --membind on top of single-node pinning buys nothing. At two cpus apiece, private leases cost hmmer 1.5-1.6x and straddling another 15%. michi 0.2.0's node-aware leases closed this. The probe's REPORT.md is in tmp-claude; its 136 GB of raw output was deleted.
